rationale: Ukrainian drone strike on Russian ships in Mediterranean shows extended operational reach affecting regional security calculus; Mali casualties indicate Russian military strain; other events distant.

top_events.title: Ukraine confirms it used naval drones to strike two Russian ships off Libya
top_events.label: Ukraine strikes Russian warships off Libya coast
top_events.summary: Ukrainian drones sank Russian vessel Merkury in Benghazi, demonstrating extended reach into Mediterranean. Affects regional security dynamics and Russian naval presence.

top_events.title: More than 300 Russians killed as Moscow props up Mali's junta, leaked data reveals
top_events.label: Russia loses 349 soldiers in Mali operations
top_events.summary: Leaked data shows 349 Russian military deaths in Mali over three years. Indicates strain on Russian forces deployed globally during Ukraine conflict.

top_events.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
top_events.label: NATO chief addresses Russian satellite threat
top_events.summary: NATO responds to reports of Russian nuclear satellite plans. Rhetorical statement without new confirmed action; existing threat continues.

short_summary: Ukrainian drone hits Russian ship Libya port

most_significant_event.label: Ukrainian drone hits Russian ship Libya port
most_significant_event.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at Libya's Benghazi naval base. The vessel had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.
most_significant_event.title: Suspected drone attack causes explosion on Russian ship in Libya
